text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho brilliantly claimed
1st place in the Takarazuka Kinen.

Together, we managed to make it through
those precious first two years... and a little bit more—...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, you're too loud!
Don't yell so suddenly!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, I had just come up with a new magic spell
and now it's gone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And the hands on that clock over there are off, too!
Fixing that is a familiar's job, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While apologizing profusely to Sweep Tosho,
I quickly fixed the clock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I couldn't just back down as a useless familiar.
As her Trainer, there was something I needed to ask her."
choice_data_list: By the way, what are we doing about the next race?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A race?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's enough of that already, right?
I cast the strongest racing magic there is anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Be-qui-eeet-!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Listen here!! The magic I wanna learn isn't *just* race magic, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Studying magic is hard work!
You need to be more considerate, too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATTLE-CLATTER! BAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Anyone hoooome~!

The one who suddenly appeared in the room
was the tomboy Umamusume who meets force with force,
Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me the magic of racing, desu wa~~!
Anybody hooome~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...! What is that 'Huh?' supposed to mean...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The 'Y' in 'Yes', is it not!?
Thank you so much for the okay~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course not!
Kawakami-idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, I don't even plan to race!
Plus, my race magic is currently on hiatus, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Shut uuup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
B-But...! I need your magic...!
Because... because...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To change her mind,
all that's left is your magic...
.........*sob* Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Why are you crying all of a sudden?!
Jeez...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So, why do we need racing magic?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ......I just wanted you to come to love racing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I want a certain senior to fall in love with racing all over again.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I had the opportunity to run alongside that senpai once before.
I was so full of spirit back then.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai was truly remarkable.
I desperately wanted to... defeat her."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The moment the race began,
I pushed forward to carve open a path.
Further ahead. Striving to get even further in front—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...There was a sudden, heavy impact.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I heard a small shriek.
When I looked back, my senior's face had gone completely pale.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: She came to a complete halt right there, stepping away from the track as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after that, I heard rumors
that she had become afraid to run.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to apologize.
However, she simply told me, 'It's not your fault,
so there is no need to apologize.'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Still, that was entirely my fault...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...That's—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I heard she was resting due to an injury after the Shuka Sho,
but she's recovered enough to run alongside someone now."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh. Sweep-san!?
Ah!? Um... long time no see?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Hey, is it true that you got too scared to run?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There seem to be some pretty wild rumors going around.
Is any of that true?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, that's—...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...It's true.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Not everything is true like the rumors say, though.
Kawakami-san really didn't do anything wrong.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"She was just competing with all she had.
The contact wasn't that bad, and I wasn't hurt or anything."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Freezing up back then was entirely my own problem.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, a problem?!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I just thought it was impossible.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I kind of suspected it while I was resting from my injury.
Even if I came back like this... I'm sure that I...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...What's that supposed to mean?
Saying it's impossible...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The proof is how I flinched when fighting for position with Kawakami-san. I was completely overpowered by her.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Besides—I saw your Takarazuka Kinen, too.
It was incredible. So incredible that I totally
understood why everyone calls it magic.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It felt so out of reach.
That's why I thought I should just quit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!? Why?
You saw my race, so why
do you think that!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stop talking that nonsense about it being out of reach
and just start over again!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "More like how you were during the Oaks and the Shuka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: It's just impossible!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I'm terrified to death of it.
Facing the reality of being completely crushed
and realizing it's all over for me.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the same as I was back then.
If you're injured and out for a whole year, anyone would get left behind. ...That's just common sense, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What's with this... "common sense"?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why do you look so bored?!
I don't get it!
I don't get it at aaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about common sense?!
Giving up over something so lame...
you're being seriously lame right now!!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Common sense is common sense! You and I are different!
I'm not an Umamusume who can work miracles,
I'm just ordinary—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that!
Things like 'normal' or 'common sense'—
I just have to blast through them with magic!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You come watch my autumn races!
I'll use my magic to turn you back to normal!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's a promise... A definite promise!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar!
What GⅠ races can I run in next!?

I consider the right GⅠ race for Sweep Tosho.
Right now, she is brimming with motivation.

A historic autumn stage where the fiercest contenders gather.
What can best utilize her distance aptitude and finishing burst is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then that's fine!
And next, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work some incredible magic at the
Tenno Sho (Autumn), so make sure you drag him along!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I understand now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Racing magic shatters boring
worlds and fills everyone with excitement—
it's an amazing kind of magic!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(I won't let you give up after seeing my magic!
Not a chance! I'll cast even more perfect,
even more amazing magic!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(All that's left needed for that is a rival.
A rival to create that special race that drives everyone wild――)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy! You're just in time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-san!?
Thank goodness.
There's something I wanted to talk to you about too..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're definitely the one
to be my rival!
Enter the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
! In the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?
Are you running in that one too, Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! Fufu,
I was actually just coming to ask if I could race with you once more.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, please! Next time... I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm counting on you to be the best rival possible!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The genius magical girl Sweepy
is gonna use super-duper ultimate magic
at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) too!
